name: John Espy
occupation: Carbon County commissioner (current term continues past 2026)
prior_offices: Carbon County commissioner (won the November 2024 general election; listed on the official commissioners page)
background: John Espy is a Carbon County commissioner. He won the November 2024 general election, and the official commissioners page lists him as a member. The Carbon County Comet reported that he was present at the February 4, 2025, meeting at which commissioners swore in a new county clerk. He was not on the 2026 county-commission ballot.
